title: Poor quality with cracks on outer finish/glaze
text: Poor quality with cracks on outer finish/glaze. My mug had cracks all through the outside glaze of the ceramic cup. One crack is so bad that I’m afraid it will leak through if I put a hot liquid inside  the cup. I don’t feel like going through the hassle of returning so will keep the mug for trinkets & enjoy the cute spoon. I’ve purchased many mugs through Amazon & have never had a problem. I was very disappointed in the quality & would not recommend this item. I’m giving it one star due to the spoon.
